notes.title: Combat 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]The long awaited combat update!!![/h1][p][/p][h3]Thank you all for your suggestions contributing to this update, and feel free to watch the attached video for more details on everything added.

[/h3][previewyoutube="wIdvab-DJbo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Total Materials QOL Patch
notes.content:
[h1]New Features
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a total empire material counter that shows the combined amount of each resource across all supply hubs
[*] Introduced loading screen tips to provide helpful info while the game loads
[*] The game now automatically zooms to your empire when joining a world for easier orientation
[/list]

notes.title: Squad Vehicles & Infrastructure Update
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the sector bug that caused issues when moving between sectors.
[*] Fixed all other known bugs for improved performance and stability.
[/list]
[h2]New Feature – Infrastructure Upgrades:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now spend gold to upgrade buildings with new infrastructure options.
[*] These upgrades add unique features to buildings and improve their capabilities.
[/list]
[h2]Truck Garage:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buildings with the Truck Garage upgrade will send squads out in military trucks.
[*] Trucks move faster than ground troops.
[*] The speed bonus only applies when squads leave a building with the garage upgrade.
[/list]
[h2]Helipad:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buildings with the Helipad upgrade deploy squads in helicopters.
[*] Helicopters move even faster than trucks.
[*] The speed bonus only applies when squads leave a building with a helipad.
[*] This update adds more strategic depth to how you manage movement and upgrades.
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition Multiplayer and Tutorial
notes.content:
What’s New
[h2]Persistent Availability
[/h2]
[list]
[*] World of Fate is now permanently live—dive in anytime
[/list]
[h2]Multiplayer
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Host your own world or browse and join publicly listed servers
[*] Shared save system: single-player and multiplayer use the same save files for seamless switching
[/list]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Logistics storage caps: set a maximum (e.g. 100 concrete) per building for easier resource management
[*] Increased soldier movement speed within sectors you control
[/list]
[h2]Tutorial System
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brand-new in-game tutorials guide you through core mechanics and interface
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] All known issues to date have been addressed and resolved
[/list]
Jump back in and enjoy!

notes.title: Basic AI Empires
notes.content:
What’s New
[h2]AI Empires
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two AI empires can exist per match
[*] Empires can capture and set building types
[*] Empires can spawn capital support squads and barracks squads
[*] Empires can attack and reinforce buildings
[/list]
[h2]Capitulation System
[/h2]
[list]
[*] If an empire’s capital is captured, the entire empire collapses
[*] Any owning player must restart upon their capital’s fall
[/list]
Bug Fixes & Polish
[list]
[*] Dozens of small gameplay issues addressed based on your initial feedback
[/list]
Dive in and see how the new AI empires change the balance of power!

notes.title: World of Fate Remastered!
notes.content:
Thank you all for sticking with us through the two-year wait. Testplay 1 of World of Fate comes with a full feature and gameplay overhaul:

[h2]• new building types
[/h2][list]
[*] [b]capital:[/b] set tax rates, deploy support squads and store up to 5,000 gold in your vault
[*] [b]bank:[/b] upgrade vault capacity and earn interest on deposits
[*] [b]hospital:[/b] heal squads and inspect wounded soldiers
[*] [b]barracks:[/b] design custom squads from soldiers with unique stats
[*] [b]factory:[/b] convert raw materials into refined goods
[*] [b]supply hub:[/b] centralized storage for construction inputs
[/list]
[h2]• combat tab improvements
[/h2][list]
[*] streamlined soldier selection
[*] enhanced squad management tools
[/list]
[h2]• sector tab
[/h2]
[list]
[*] create and name sectors
[*] capture sectors by seizing buildings within them
[/list]
[h2]• logistics tab
[/h2]
[list]
[*] link buildings with transport lines
[*] build full production chains to move resources automatically
[/list]
[h2]• construction tab
[/h2][list]
[*] erect new buildings and machines in owned sectors
[*] build mining drills to harvest raw resources
[*] assemble missile silos and manufacture missiles via your logistics and factories
[*] launch missiles (and nukes) to devastate areas—each explosion leaves a radiation zone that grants attackers a 10× bonus but renders any buildings within unusable until the radiation clears
[/list]
Dive in, explore the new systems, and let us know what you think!
